extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology constraints from primary text/Figures 4-7 and supplement Figure S1; PI/nucleic-acid wording is retained only as readout context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TC-14 directly increases bacterial membrane permeability in E. coli, A. baumannii, P. aeruginosa, and S. aureus as measured by propidium-iodide fluorescence after peptide addition.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=TC-14 kills bacteria by inducing membrane permeabilization and rupture; xml:fig=5:Figure 4

mechanism_claims.limitations: PI binds DNA/RNA after membrane entry; the assay supports membrane permeability, not a nucleic-acid molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TC-14 treatment causes membrane disruption, content leakage, cytoplasmic clear zones, and cell lysis morphology in P. aeruginosa and S. aureus by SEM/TEM imaging.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=TC-14 kills bacteria by inducing membrane permeabilization and rupture; xml:fig=6:Figure 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane/cell-envelope disruption but does not identify a specific molecular receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TC-14 has bactericidal kinetic evidence at 5 x MIC against A. baumannii and S. aureus, with A. baumannii eradicated by 180 min and S. aureus reduced by more than 99% by 180 min under the reported assay.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=TC-14 shows medium killing rate and low propensity to induce resistance; xml:fig=7:Figure 6

mechanism_claims.limitations: Bactericidal kinetics constrain activity and resistance interpretation but do not by themselves prove molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TC-14 shows in vivo skin-wound efficacy against S. aureus and A. baumannii infection models, but this is pharmacodynamic efficacy rather than a separate molecular mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=TC-14 shows therapeutic potential against skin infection; xml:fig=8:Figure 7

mechanism_claims.limitations: No host immunomodulatory mechanism is assigned from these efficacy data.

semantic_quality_checks.nucleic_acid_overclaim: absent; PI/nucleic acid wording is assay readout context only
semantic_quality_checks.mechanism_status: direct membrane-permeabilization and membrane-rupture evidence with bounded kinetics/in-vivo context
